abstract: Voluntary adoption of pollution prevention (P2) practices has been used to reduce toxic emissions in the US. Spillovers among facilities owned by the same firm likely play an important role in the diffusion of P2 practices. This article estimates the intrafirm spillover effects of P2 adoption. Using instrumental variables methods applied to facility panel data from the Toxics Release Inventory, we find that a facility’s own adoption of P2 practices increases in response to greater P2 adoption by facilities from the same firm. Intrafirm spillovers are stronger among small firms and firms with higher degree of sibling homophily. JEL Q55Q58
abstract_zh: 美国通过自愿采纳污染预防（P2）实践来减少有毒排放。同一企业旗下设施之间的溢出效应可能在P2实践的扩散中发挥重要作用。本文估计了P2采纳的企业内溢出效应。利用应用于有毒物质排放清单设施面板数据的工具变量方法，我们发现，当同一企业内其他设施采纳P2实践增多时，设施自身采纳P2实践的可能性也随之增加。企业内溢出效应在小企业和兄弟设施同质性较高的企业中更为显著。JEL分类号：Q55，Q58
title: Does Peer Adoption Increase the Diffusion of Pollution Prevention Practices?
title_zh: 同行采纳是否会增加污染预防实践的扩散？

abstract: Flooding is the natural disaster that causes the most damage. Postflood, many families are not insured and do not have sufficient savings for rebuilding, and governmental aid can be limited. We undertake, using a stated preference survey, the first willingness-to-pay (WTP) elicitation for flood insurance in the United States. WTP increases with modeled flood risk and flood-risk perceptions. WTP for residents in our study area’s 100-year floodplain is 47% to 59% of the median flood insurance premium, which suggests the need for financial assistance for families who are at risk of flood damage and are unable to afford risk-based premiums. abstract_zh: 洪水是造成损失最严重的自然灾害。灾后，许多家庭既未投保，也缺乏足够的储蓄用于重建，而政府援助可能有限。我们通过一项陈述偏好调查，首次在美国进行了洪水保险支付意愿（WTP）的测度。支付意愿随模拟洪水风险和洪水风险认知的增加而提高。我们研究区域内百年一遇洪水淹没区居民的支付意愿为洪水保险中位保费的47%至59%，这表明，对于面临洪水风险且无力承担基于风险的保费的家庭，有必要提供财务援助。JEL Q54Q58 本开放获取文章依据CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0）分发，并可在以下网址免费在线获取：http://le.uwpress.org。

title: The Willingness to Pay for Flood Insurance

abstract: A criticism against individual-based stated preference surveys is that people seldom make choices in social isolation. An approach used in response to this is deliberative valuation. We conduct a series of valuation workshops including a choice experiment. This involves providing respondents with information and opportunity to discuss. They made their choices individually both before and after the discussion. On average respondents stated different preferences after the discussion compared to before, and the stated preferences became more consistent after deliberation. Unexpectedly, persons stating high certainty of pre-deliberation choices changed stated preferences more after deliberation than persons stating lower certainty of choices. JEL Q51Q57
abstract_zh: 针对基于个体的陈述偏好调查，一个批评是人们在做出选择时很少处于社会孤立状态。为应对此问题，一种方法是审议式评估。我们开展了一系列评估工作坊，其中包括一项选择实验。这涉及向受访者提供信息并给予讨论机会。他们在讨论前后分别独立做出选择。平均而言，受访者在讨论后陈述的偏好与讨论前相比有所不同，且审议后陈述的偏好变得更加一致。出乎意料的是，在审议前选择中表示高度确定性的个体，在审议后改变陈述偏好的程度大于表示较低确定性的个体。JEL分类号：Q51 Q57
title: Do We Choose Differently after a Discussion? Results from a Deliberative Valuation Study in Ireland

abstract: In this study, participants from Beijing, China, were offered the opportunity to contribute to voluntary climate change mitigation by purchasing permits from two Chinese CO2 emissions trading schemes (ETS). Since CO2 emissions abatement is linked to other local benefits like the reduction in emissions of air pollutants, our aim is to separate the demand for local and global environmental protection. To this end, Beijing and Shenzhen ETS permits were offered. Our results indicate that a substantial part of the revealed demand for voluntary climate change mitigation in Beijing is driven by concerns for local co-benefits of CO2 emissions reduction. JEL Q51Q54
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，来自中国北京的参与者被提供了通过购买两个中国二氧化碳排放交易体系（ETS）的许可证来自愿参与气候变化减缓的机会。由于二氧化碳减排与减少空气污染物排放等其他地方性益处相关联，我们的目标是区分对地方和全球环境保护的需求。为此，我们提供了北京和深圳ETS的许可证。结果表明，在北京，自愿气候变化减缓所显现的需求中，有很大一部分是由对二氧化碳减排地方性协同效益的关注所驱动的。JEL分类号：Q51，Q54

abstract: This article examines the effect of flooding on agricultural land prices in the Fargo-Moorhead area in two ways: (1) hydraulic modeling data and sales data are used to estimate the effects of flooding and flood severity; and (2) the data are combined with 100-year floodplain information to examine how effects vary across flood-risk categories. Results indicate inundation negatively affects all property; however, effects differ based on floodplain status. Property outside floodplains is affected by coverage, while property within floodplains is affected by depth. All effects are temporary, as they disappear within two years after a flood event. JEL Q51Q54
abstract_zh: 本文从两个维度考察了洪水对法戈-穆尔黑德地区农业土地价格的影响：（1）利用水力学建模数据与销售数据，估算洪水及其严重程度的影响效应；（2）将这些数据与百年一遇洪泛区信息相结合，分析影响在不同洪水风险类别间的差异。研究结果表明，淹没对所有财产均产生负面影响；然而，影响因洪泛区状态而异。位于洪泛区外的财产受淹没范围影响，而位于洪泛区内的财产则受淹没深度影响。所有影响均为暂时性的，在洪水事件发生后的两年内消失。JEL分类号：Q51，Q54
title: Flooding and the Value of Agricultural Land

abstract: This article uses a field experiment to evaluate effects of monetary treatments on usage intensity of an important improved biomass-burning cookstove promoted in Ethiopia. Understanding whether, how much and why improved stoves are used are important, because use frequency critically determines fuelwood savings and related benefits. We find that distributing stoves free-of-charge is at least as effective for promoting short-run adoption as requiring payments or offering usage incentives. Free distribution is most effective at promoting both high and increasing levels of longer-run regular use. First period incentives do not better promote usage habits compared with the other two treatments. JEL O12O13
abstract_zh: 本文通过一项实地实验，评估了货币干预措施对埃塞俄比亚推广的一种重要改良生物质燃烧炉使用强度的影响。理解改良炉具是否被使用、使用程度及原因至关重要，因为使用频率直接决定薪柴节约量及相关效益。我们发现，免费发放炉具在促进短期采用方面至少与要求付款或提供使用激励同样有效。免费分发在促进长期规律使用的较高水平和持续增长方面最为有效。与另外两种处理方式相比，首期激励并未更好地促进使用习惯的形成。JEL分类号：O12，O13
authors: A. D., Gebreegziabher, Z., Martinsson, P., Mekonnen, A., Vieider

abstract: Budget-constrained environmental agencies across the United States are limited in their ability to monitor water quality changes using traditional in situ sampling. Satellite-based monitoring systems represent a lower-cost alternative. It is unclear, however, how this transition will impact nonmarket valuation estimates of perceived water quality. To answer this question, we merge housing information with Secchi depth and satellite estimates of water clarity from over 100 lakes in Wisconsin. A comparison of hedonic price functions reveals satellite estimates of water clarity provide a stronger statistical fit of housing price and produce implicit prices up to 11% larger in magnitude. JEL Q51Q57
abstract_zh: 美国各地受预算约束的环境机构在利用传统原位采样监测水质变化方面能力有限。基于卫星的监测系统代表了一种成本更低的替代方案。然而，这一转变将如何影响感知水质的非市场价值评估估计尚不明确。为回答此问题，我们将住房信息与威斯康星州100多个湖泊的Secchi深度及卫星估算的水体清澈度数据相结合。对特征价格函数的比较显示，卫星估算的水体清澈度对住房价格具有更强的统计拟合度，并产生幅度高达11%的隐含价格。JEL Q51Q57

abstract: We estimate U.S. organic farmers’ marginal willingness to pay to rent an acre of certified organic land relative to conventional farmland. Using a selection-on-observables design and farm-level data on farmland rental rates, organic status, and many conditioning variables, we address the role of profitability in mediating the effect of organic status. We find a 26% rental rate premium for organic farmland not driven by higher profits on organic farms. This premium is a modest incentive for landowners but a barrier for tenants to convert to organic farming practices, which may explain limited growth in U.S. organic acreage. abstract_zh: 我们估算了美国有机农户相对于传统农田，为租用一英亩经认证的有机土地所愿意支付的边际意愿。采用基于可观测变量的选择设计，并结合农场层面的农田租金率、有机状态及众多条件变量的数据，我们探讨了盈利能力在调节有机状态效应中的作用。我们发现，有机农田的租金率溢价为26%，这一溢价并非由有机农场更高的利润所驱动。这一溢价对土地所有者而言是适度的激励，但对租户而言则是转向有机耕作实践的障碍，这可能解释了美国有机种植面积增长有限的原因。JEL分类号：Q11 Q15。本开放获取文章依据CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0）分发，并可在以下网址免费在线获取：http://er.uwpress.org。

abstract: Using county data from California between 2004 and 2017, this article exploits changes in households’ exposure to hazardous waste recycling to identify the effects on potential environmental and economic outcomes. While a 10% rise in recycling per household is associated with a 0.28% and 0.94% improvement in air quality and a decline in the number of unhealthy days in a year, recycling is associated with a rise in net energy generation and fuel consumption and not associated with economic activity. There is some evidence that households in zip codes with higher housing values and population density value reductions in hazardous waste. JEL Q53Q58
abstract_zh: 本文利用2004年至2017年间加利福尼亚州的县级数据，通过家庭暴露于危险废物回收的变化来识别其对潜在环境和经济结果的影响。尽管每户回收量增加10%与空气质量改善0.28%和0.94%以及一年中不健康天数减少相关，但回收与净能源发电量和燃料消耗的增加相关，且与经济活动无关联。有证据表明，住房价值较高和人口密度较大的邮政编码区域内的家庭更看重危险废物的减少。JEL分类号：Q53，Q58
title: Is Recycling Effective? Evidence from California between 2004 and 2017
title_zh: 回收是否有效？来自加利福尼亚州2004年至2017年的证据
